verdict.rationale: Exa documents an official, open-source MCP server with a setup guide for connecting Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Codex and any other MCP client. It exposes web search, code search, page fetching, Exa Agent and Exa Connect tools, and needs no API key to start. A probe confirms the official MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
